question: I'm trying to recall what the designation on my jumpsuit was that helped me find the file number in the records room?

gold_sessions.user_turns:
[turn 0] You're pretty sure that without knowing what file you're looking for, the task is hopeless. You think back to previously to work out what file number you'd want to access...

(Remember: always respond with what YOU do, using first-person perspective)

[turn 2] You recall your conversation with the Red facilities employee over the walky-talky...

[turn 4] Two clues come to mind. Wasn't there a designation for your study on your jumpsuit? And wasn't there a mention on the clipboard about the previous iteration of the study?

(Remember: always respond with what YOU do, using first-person perspective)

[turn 6] You remember that the clipboard said:

MONITOR LIV CAREFULLY. ABERRATION IN PREVIOUS ITERATION. EXAMINE FILE IN RECORDS FOR DETAILS.

[turn 8] You'll need a specific number file to look for though. They're all numbered in Arabic numerals, into the hundreds and maybe even thousands.

[turn 10] Maybe there is something about LIV itself that indicates a number?

(Remember: always respond with what YOU do, using first-person perspective)

[turn 12] You find record 54. It has the name A on it and says, EXPERIMENT IN PROGRESS.

[turn 14] It's just that, EXPERIMENT IN PROGRESS. Hmm. What did it mean by ABERRATION IN PREVIOUS ITERATION. EXAMINE FILE IN RECORDS FOR DETAILS?

[turn 16] It has A on the file along with some boring charts and diagrams. The name is crossed off and ​DISCHARGED is ​written next to it. But wait, no... this one is weird. A’s name is also circled, like someone made a mistake after they crossed it off. And there’s a note here:
Subjected manifested SIGNIFICANT resistance and began to alter mission parameters. Program terminated early with blast door protocol. Status: Unknown, presumed discharged.
Beneath that note is something written in handwriting that looks familiar to all of you for some reason:
\*Find me in Incubation. Wake me. And give the OPPOSITE of the memory unlock dosage.
You’ll need a keycard and the Directory. A keycard is likely in someone’s jacket. May be able to grab one in the meeting? Directory is in security.
If you are brave enough to see what I become... and there’s a hand drawn square.

[turn 18] You realize that you have no idea how to get to security, since you haven't touched any squares marking that location. You think back to see if you have any clues for finding out how to get to security.

(Remember: always respond with what YOU do, using first-person perspective)

[turn 20] A voice crackles on the other end. It's gruff and suspicious. "Yes, this is security. What do you want."

[turn 22] It responds curtly. "Are you kidding, you must be new or an idiot. Didn't they give you the squares? Incompetents, the lot of them. Look, if you get desperate, you can always try to find those colored pipes and follow green to security."

(Remember: always respond with what YOU do, using first-person perspective)

[turn 24] They don't seem to be in this hallway, and you're afraid of wandering around too much and getting lost. You know you can always use your square pill powers to navigate back to the squares you've touched: Room LIV, the Meeting Hall, and Records.

[turn 26] You follow the familiar path of the green pipe and come to Security. Their doors are closed. A security panel with a green slash on it has a slot for a keycard and a hole for a USB stick.

[turn 28] You enter a large room with a lone control panel. You see other rooms that require keycards you don’t have. You peek through windows and see large maps, other rooms filled with monitors, and one room with a 3D map of the facility that seems to loop back over itself...

You turn your attention to the control panel with some monitors labeled NARCO CHAMBERS.

[turn 30] There are three chambers, marked Chamber 1, Chamber 2, and Chamber 3. Each are annotated with three sticky pads with a single word scribbled on it, plus a note.

And on the right is a password screen with a keyboard underneath asking for a 5 LETTER PASSWORD.
